author: Brad Spears
title: GameStop (GME) stock down on Apple rumors
text:
GameStop (GME) stock down on Apple rumors January 28 2019 10:49 AM Brad Spears
Shares of GameStop Corp. ( GME ) stock are down on rumors that Apple ( AAPL ) is developing a subscription service for gaming. The service would allow gamers to access an undisclosed list of gaming titles, similar to how people interact with subscription services like Netflix ( NFLX ) and HULU. These recent developments come as Apple seeks to expand into a larger market of services as iPhone and iPad sales begin to decline.
GameStop stock is trading at $15.42 as of 10:28 AM on Monday, Jan 28, a drop of -$0.48, or -3.02% from the previous closing price of $15.90. GME stock has traded between $14.99 and $15.79 so far today. Volume today is below average. So far 295,238 shares have traded compared to average volume of 2,994,994 shares.
Meanwhile, the major indices are falling. The S&P 500 has fallen -1.21% to 2,632.63. The S&P 500 is lower by -1.21% to 2,632.63. The NASDAQ is lower by -1.28% to 7,072.89.
